uncataloged.reason: Confirmed in code but not the same root cause as any of the 5 golden entries for this file. cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh line 66 excludes any Bash command containing a quote character from the cat-target tokenizer entirely (falls to the empty no-op case arm before the set -- tokenization at line 69 ever runs), so target is never set and the command is allowed through undenied -- even for an exact single-argument cat whose path is quoted, e.g. cat with a quoted docs/rules path. GV3-166 (the closest golden entry) describes bypasses via non-exact command forms -- flags, other utilities, other tools, relative Read paths -- on the premise that an exact bare cat-path form IS detected; it does not identify that quoting the path alone defeats detection even for that exact form. This is a distinct, genuine in-range defect (skill-invoke-gate.sh is new in this diff) the golden does not catalog.
